league_wrap.title: Camp Desk — Wednesday, Sep 2
league_wrap.bottom_line: Named starter (Cousins) + Australia travel (Kittle/Bosa) + TB WR practice status. Not a 32-card dump. Existing LAC Under 2/5 and DEN Over 2/5 stand. Everything else Pass.
storylines: 49ers: Kittle and Bosa are on the Wednesday plane to Australia. Kittle logged two positive practice days and is trending toward Week 1 vs LAR in Melbourne; Bosa is still ramping the knee — trip ≠ active. Availability is up vs Monday’s sit risk. Pass on crowning TE1/EDGE1.

Raiders: Kubiak named Kirk Cousins the Week 1 starter Wednesday (over Mendoza / O’Connell). Cousins’ Wednesday DNP was a planned vet rest day, not an injury. Jeanty (ankle) still on the mend with Kubiak optimistic for Week 1 vs MIA. DE Keyron Crawford is out for the 2026 season (Achilles). Pass on inventing QB2.

Bucs: Claimed CB Kevin Knowles off Chiefs waivers Tuesday evening (Fordham waived). Tue practice: Egbuka (toe) and McMillan (knee) DNP; Bain (shoulder) returned. Bowles day-to-day / “feel better when I see next week”; NFL.com Wed roundup paraphrases the WRs as “headed in the right direction” for Week 1 at CIN — hopeful language, still not practicing. Fallback if both sit: Godwin / Hurst / Tez Johnson. Pass on crowning WR1/EDGE.

Vikings: Kyle Van Noy signed to the practice squad Wednesday; Pelissero: ramp on the PS, then elevate to the 53. Also PS: Brosmer, DeeJay Dallas, Dillon Bell. Depth intel only — Pass on an EDGE crown.
league_wrap.what_to_watch: Melbourne practice for Kittle/Bosa; Jeanty ankle into Week 1; TB WR participation next week; Van Noy elevation clock. LAC Under 2/5 and DEN Over 2/5 stand — no chase.
